main.description: A place saved by a user. The primary entity of Placita: one record per place, stored in the user's own repository.

name.description: Name of the place as the user saved it.

status.description: want means the user wants to go there. been means the user has been there.

visibility.description: Whether Placita shows this place in public discovery. This is a display hint only: every record in an AT Protocol repository can be read by anyone, including hidden ones.

location.description: Where the place is. Normally community.lexicon.location.geo: coordinates as strings, with the street address in its name field when known.

osmType.description: Type of the linked OpenStreetMap feature. Set only when the user confirmed the match. Used together with osmId.

osmId.description: ID of the linked OpenStreetMap feature as a decimal string. Used together with osmType.

source.description: Where the place came from: a map or review link the user pasted, an OpenStreetMap search result, or manual entry.

sourceUrl.description: The link the place was created from, when there was one.

sourcePhotoUrl.description: URL of a free-licensed photo found for this place (Wikimedia Commons, OSM image tag, Wikidata P18). Not a blob - it is a reference to an external image, with attribution.

sourcePhotoLicense.description: License of sourcePhotoUrl, e.g. CC BY-SA 4.0. Attribution duty applies when shown.

sourcePhotoAuthor.description: Creator or credit text returned by Wikimedia Commons for sourcePhotoUrl.

sourcePhotoLicenseUrl.description: License details URL returned by Wikimedia Commons.

sourcePhotoPageUrl.description: Source file page URL for attribution and reuse details.

sourcePhotoSourceName.description: Origin label for the source photo suggestion.

tags.description: The user's tags for this place, as strong references to app.placita.tag records.

note.description: The user's own note about the place.

noteTitle.description: Optional short title for the note.

phone.description: The place's phone number, as entered or taken from OpenStreetMap.

openingHours.description: Opening hours in OpenStreetMap opening_hours syntax, for example Mo-Su 09:00-18:00.

category.description: Place type from Placita's fixed list, for example restaurant, cafe or museum. Missing or unknown means generic.

photo.description: Legacy single photo. Only older records have it. New records use photos.

photos.description: Photos the user uploaded for this place. Up to 4.

rating.description: The user's own rating of the place, from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent). Only set when status is been. Absent means not rated.

placeCode.description: An opaque random code that names the place itself, for a place with no confirmed OpenStreetMap link. The person who first saves such a place makes it; every copy another person saves keeps it unchanged, so copies of one place can be found together. Not set when the place has an OpenStreetMap link, which names the place instead. Lowercase letters and the digits 2 to 7.

photoCredit.description: Who took the photos in photos, when they are not the person who owns this record, for example because they were copied from a public place of another person. Free text such as Photos by @alice.example. Only set together with photos.

postRef.description: Reference to the Bluesky post this place was shared as. The post links to this person's public page for the place. Set when the owner shares the place from Placita; absent otherwise.

osm.description: Details in OpenStreetMap's own words (structured address, tags). Copied from OpenStreetMap when the place is linked (see checkedAt), and editable by the person (see editedAt). May also hold details typed for a place with no link. A copy made at a point in time: it is not kept up to date.

osmDetails.description: Address and tags in OpenStreetMap's vocabulary: a copy of what OpenStreetMap knew about the linked feature at checkedAt, and/or what the person typed (editedAt). Data copied from OpenStreetMap is (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database Licence (ODbL). Treat the values as suggestions: they can be wrong or out of date, and the user's own fields always win.

checkedAt.description: When the details were copied from OpenStreetMap. Absent for details that were only typed.

address.description: The structured address OpenStreetMap has for the feature.

tags.description: Raw OpenStreetMap tags (key and value) of the feature, such as cuisine, wheelchair or wikidata. Tags already stored in other fields (name, website, phone, opening hours) and OpenStreetMap-internal tags (source, note, fixme) are left out. At most 60.

editedAt.description: When the person last changed these details by hand, or typed them. Details with no checkedAt were never copied from OpenStreetMap.

osmAddress.description: A structured address, as OpenStreetMap returns it. Every part is optional.

countryCode.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code, upper case.

key.description: The tag key, for example cuisine.

value.description: The tag value, for example italian;pizza. Values over 255 characters are not stored.
